properties.rationale: Acknowledged on Anthony's word, 2026-07-28: validation is tracked OUTSIDE this graph and deliberately so. The real fitness-for-purpose evidence is the trials — the brownfield trial on ophyd-service and the greenfield trial on aidrone, both logged in docs/trials-private/ — plus sustained real usage of the StoryFlow fleet. None of these are modelled as Verification nodes of kind=validation, and backfilling 67 of them would manufacture records where the evidence lives in prose and in use. The spec-level verifications that DO exist are genuine and passing; this gap marks the boundary of what the graph claims to know, not a hole in the testing. Revisit if trial findings start needing to be traceable per-capability.
